# The Expansion Decision

Meridian's board approved the EV expansion in early 2022. Figure 2.1
shows the sequence that followed — generated with Graphviz and
embedded as a normal figure, exactly as this toolkit recommends for
diagrams (see the main README's "Diagrams" section for why native
Quarto diagram rendering is deliberately avoided here).

![The sequence Meridian followed after approving its EV expansion.](figures/expansion-timeline.png){#fig-timeline width="90%" fig-alt="A left-to-right flow diagram: core business stable, leads to expansion approved, leads to EV unit launched, leads to core business neglected, leads to both units underperform."}

Widening the comparison across all three of Meridian's business
lines — including the food-delivery pilot it had also launched —
needs more horizontal room than a portrait page comfortably allows.
This is exactly the case this toolkit's landscape-page support
exists for.

The Head of Operations holding both the core business and the
food-delivery pilot — visible in Table 2.1 — is the kind of detail
easy to miss in a narrative summary and hard to miss in a table:
the same finding [@demo2021founder] shows up here as a structural
fact, not an opinion.
